Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 04/06/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 231 as introduced would provide an individual income tax deduction, up to $5,000 annually, on contributions made, on or after January 1, 2021, to an Alabama Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) account. Based upon the number of existing accounts, this could reduce receipts deposited into the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $90,000 annually.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 04/14/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 231 as introduced would provide an individual income tax deduction, up to $5,000 annually, on contributions made, on or after January 1, 2021, to an Alabama Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) account. Based upon the number of existing accounts, this could reduce receipts deposited into the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $90,000 annually.
As amended and reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education, the provisions of this bill would sunset on December 31, 2025, unless extended by an act of the Legislature.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Committee: Ways and Means Education
Sponsor: Barfoot

Date: 05/03/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 231 as passed the Senate would provide an individual income tax deduction of up to $5,000 annually on contributions made on or after January 1, 2021 to an Alabama Achieving a Better Life Experience (ABLE) account. Based upon the number of existing accounts, this could reduce receipts deposited into the Education Trust Fund by an estimated $90,000 annually. This deduction would sunset on December 31, 2025, unless extended by an act of the Legislature.
Bill Poole, Chair
Ways and Means Education
